investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Stratpath Education (online learning); Platform: Microsoft Azure southeastasia (zones southeastasia-1/southeastasia-2/southeastasia-3); network range 10.199.0.0/16; Edge tier: api-gateway (Envoy) on dedicated instances; gateway configuration is distributed from a config repository by a sync service; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
